mapper.sql: component_id, name, platform, repo_owner, repo_name, repo_url, category, language, license, used_by_module, current_version, latest_version, latest_release_date, update_status, star_count, fork_count, open_issue_count, description, homepage, sync_enabled, last_sync_time, last_sync_status, last_sync_message, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM open_component WHERE sync_enabled = 1 ORDER BY component_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO open_component (name, platform, repo_owner, repo_name, repo_url, category, language, license, used_by_module, current_version, latest_version, latest_release_date, update_status, star_count, fork_count, open_issue_count, description, homepage, sync_enabled, last_sync_status) VALUES (#{name}, #{platform}, #{repoOwner}, #{repoName}, #{repoUrl}, #{category}, #{language}, #{license}, #{usedByModule}, #{currentVersion}, #{latestVersion}, #{latestReleaseDate}, IFNULL(#{updateStatus}, 'UNKNOWN'), IFNULL(#{starCount}, 0), IFNULL(#{forkCount}, 0), IFNULL(#{openIssueCount}, 0), #{description}, #{homepage}, IFNULL(#{syncEnabled}, 1), #{lastSyncStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE open_component SET latest_version = IFNULL(#{latestVersion}, latest_version), latest_release_date = IFNULL(#{latestReleaseDate}, latest_release_date), update_status = IFNULL(#{updateStatus}, update_status), star_count = IFNULL(#{starCount}, star_count), fork_count = IFNULL(#{forkCount}, fork_count), open_issue_count = IFNULL(#{openIssueCount}, open_issue_count), description = IFNULL(#{description}, description), homepage = IFNULL(#{homepage}, homepage), last_sync_time = NOW(), last_sync_status = #{syncStatus}, last_sync_message = #{syncMessage} WHERE component_id = #{componentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM open_component WHERE platform = #{platform}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM open_component WHERE update_status = #{updateStatus}
